messages.text: Why a German football superstar is now playing in the third tier

metadata.summary: "Not normal." It is a phrase that Alexandra Popp turns to more than once when speaking after her debut for Borussia Dortmund. She has scored twice. The team has won 3-0. Nothing unusual there. But the crowd of 4,572 in Germany's third tier is new.
metadata.content: Alexandra Popp's inspiring debut for Borussia Dortmund draws crowd of 4,527 to third-tier women's game in Germany | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Alexandra Popp's inspiring debut for Borussia Dortmund draws crowd of 4,527 to third-tier women's game in Germany Alexandra Popp scored twice on her debut for Borussia Dortmund in their 3-0 win over Arminia Bielefeld. Adam Bate was there to see it and speak to the German legend about walking away from top-level football to join the third division club she supported as a girl... Adam Bate Football Features Writer @ghostgoal Friday 21 August 2026 07:53, UK Image: Germany legend Alexandra Popp is introduced to the Borussia Dortmund crowd "Not normal." It is a phrase that Alexandra Popp turns to more than once when speaking after her debut for Borussia Dortmund. She has scored twice. The team has won 3-0. Nothing unusual there. But the crowd of 4,572 in Germany's third tier is new. Popp is already a phenomenon here. The average attendance at Dortmund last season was below half the number at the atmospheric Stadion Rote Erde for this game against Arminia Bielefeld. Season ticket sales have almost tripled from 600 to 1700. It is because Popp has come. This summer, the former captain of the Germany national team with 67 international goals to her name joined the club she supported as a girl. messages.text: Kalpana shows guts to go with her class in Yorkshire Oaks

metadata.summary: King George heroine Kalpana just held on to land the Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks at York after a mighty scare from Sparan Nua.
metadata.content: Kalpana wins Yorkshire Oaks as gutsy display enough to see off Sparan Nua on day two of Ebor meeting | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Kalpana wins Yorkshire Oaks as gutsy display enough to see off Sparan Nua on day two of Ebor meeting Kalpana backed up her King George success with another gutsy display to see off the fast-finishing Sparan Nua in a thrilling end to the Thursday feature on the Knavesmire. Thursday 20 August 2026 16:23, UK Image: Kalpana ridden by Colin Keane (left) passes Sparan Nua ridden by Rossa Ryan on the way to winning the Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks King George heroine Kalpana just held on to land the Legends Global Yorkshire Oaks at York after a mighty scare from Sparan Nua. Aidan O'Brien's outsider Sugar Island was immediately sent to the front and Ronan Whelan quickly distanced himself from the field, extending the advantage to 20 lengths turning for home. But as the main players began to eat into that lead, Colin Keane sent Kalpana to give chase over three furlongs out, hitting top gear two furlongs from home, only for Jim Bolger's Sparan Nua - who got a little squeezed at one stage - to make up plenty of ground and close the gap. The line just came in time for the 10-11 favourite to hold on by a short head, giving Keane, Andrew Balding and owners Juddmonte a second Group One in the space of 24 hours, after Item had landed the showpiece Juddmonte International on Wednesday.
